```{=html}
<h1 class="h1">Introduction to Computing</h1>
<p class="role">ES 112 · IIT Gandhinagar · Winter 2022</p>
<p class="lede" style="margin-top:18px">A first course in computing, whose goal is to introduce the fundamental principles of computational thinking. This immersive edition ran over four weeks, with a two-hour lecture every weekday and two lab sessions a week, from variables and conditionals through loops, lists and strings to functions, closures and dictionaries in Python.</p>
<dl class="facts">
  <dt>Instructors</dt><dd><a href="https://nipunbatra.github.io">Prof. Nipun Batra</a> (<a href="mailto:nipun.batra@iitgn.ac.in">nipun.batra@iitgn.ac.in</a>) and Prof. Balagopal Komarath (<a href="mailto:bkomarath@iitgn.ac.in">bkomarath@iitgn.ac.in</a>)</dd>
  <dt>Lectures</dt><dd>Monday to Friday, 11:00 am–1:00 pm, Jasubhai Auditorium; occasionally on Saturday</dd>
  <dt>Labs</dt><dd>Two sessions a week in 7/108 or 7/109; see <a href="#labs">lab sections</a></dd>
  <dt>Office hours</dt><dd>Prof. Nipun Batra: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday, 3:00–3:30 pm, AB6/407D; walk in without an appointment</dd>
  <dt>Discussion</dt><dd>The course is delivered via <a href="https://join.slack.com/t/slack-v4e4710/shared_invite/zt-1jcu38grm-TxYbLQj0AYiVB0CVLQrrHg">Slack</a></dd>
</dl>
```

```{=html}
<div class="two rule-top">
<section id="faq"><h2>Questions</h2>
<details class="q" id="delivery"><summary>How is the course delivered?</summary><p>Via Slack. Registered students are added automatically; if you were not, <a href="https://join.slack.com/t/slack-v4e4710/shared_invite/zt-1jcu38grm-TxYbLQj0AYiVB0CVLQrrHg">add yourself here</a>.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="section"><summary>Which lab section am I in?</summary><p>See the <a href="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1hYW8WhSTYLtZ9jKeodD1Vq7Of9HQ-BLTxNH5zMTWt3Q/edit?usp=sharing">sections spreadsheet</a> (requires an IIT Gandhinagar sign-in), then find your times under <a href="#labs">lab sections</a>.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="worksheets"><summary>How many worksheets count?</summary><p>The best six of eight, at 8 marks each, for 48% of the grade. There are about two worksheets a week.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="extensions"><summary>Can I get an extension on a programming assignment?</summary><p>No. There is one programming assignment a week, and there are no extensions. See the <a href="assessment.html#deadlines">dates</a>.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="recordings"><summary>Where are the lecture recordings?</summary><p>Each lecture on the <a href="schedule.html">Lectures</a> page links its recording, and all of them are in a <a href="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1h3vz7sbIEwuzO9CO3WNG4bYADdjeYmp9?usp=sharing">Google Drive folder</a>. You need to be signed in with your IIT Gandhinagar email to view them.</p></details>
</section>
<section id="references"><h2>Core syllabus</h2>
<p class="small muted">The topics covered depend on the pace of the class, among other things.</p>
<ul class="refs">
  <li>Variables and expressions</li>
  <li>Conditionals</li>
  <li>Loops and iteration</li>
  <li>Functions</li>
  <li>Strings</li>
  <li>Lists</li>
  <li>Dictionaries</li>
  <li>Tuples</li>
  <li>Object-oriented programming</li>
</ul>
<p class="small muted" style="margin-top:14px">For practice, try the <a href="challenge.html">challenging questions</a>.</p>
</section>
</div>
```
